name: jira.my_open_issues
summary: My open Jira issues: tickets assigned to me (currentUser) that are not done, recently updated first

project.description: optional project key to limit the search to, e.g. PROJ

args.jql: assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory != Done{{#project}} AND project = "{{project}}"{{/project}} ORDER BY updated DESC
